datasets.label: INCLUDE v2 videos and keypoints
datasets.count_basis: One row per aligned v2 video, joined by clip ID to the matching keypoints for category labels.
notes: All video IDs, corrected sign labels and split assignments match the frozen v2 keypoint manifest.
Category counts use each clip’s dataset category. Clock has clips in Electronics and Home, with its test clip in Home.
Coverage counts distinct signs across all categories. The v2 release uses clip-level splits.

demo.label: Frozen Transformer validation cohort
notes: All 720 evaluation clips belong to the saved iPad validation split; 630 have a matched public source video and 90 do not.
The 630 matched public videos sit in 434 train, 48 validation and 148 test folders. These public folder assignments differ from the saved iPad validation assignments.
Epoch 102 was selected on this validation panel. Signer independence and held-out test performance are not established.
Nine later metadata label corrections are not applied to this pinned evaluation cohort.
